tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Photographic Genres and Styles

questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring photographic genres and styles. Annotate your process.
questions.correctAnswer: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to photographic genres and styles, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with photographic genres and styles. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.
questions.correctAnswer: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with photographic genres and styles. Which approaches were most successful and why?
questions.correctAnswer: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on Photographic Genres and Styles

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Create a small portfolio of 6-8 photographs within one genre. Research a photographer working in the same genre and show how their approach has informed your own. Annotate your creative decisions. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: demonstrate understanding of genre conventions; create a coherent portfolio with consistent visual language; research a relevant photographer with specific analysis; show how research has informed personal style; annotate creative decisions with specialist vocabulary. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
